item.title: AT&T and Microsoft scale trillion-token workloads with Microsoft Foundry and AMD
item.description: AT&T processed approximately one trillion tokens while developing OTel2.0 using Microsoft Foundry Managed Compute, open AI models, and AMD and NVIDIA GPU infrastructure. Discover how flexible model choice and scalable infrastructure are enabling production-scale telecom AI. The post AT&T and Microsoft scale trillion-token workloads with Microsoft Foundry and AMD appeared first on Microsoft Azure Blog. Link to article: https://azure.microsoft.com/en-us/blog/att-and-microsoft-scale-trillion-token-workloads-with-microsoft-foundry-and-amd/
